title: No Kin of Ours

texts.details:
I have thought on what you saw, and I have prayed on it.

They were our kin. That is true, and it changes nothing. The Highborne broke the world for the sake of their own magic, and these are the ones who never repented of it. They serve Azshara as a goddess. And they have taken a city of ours and filled it with warriors.

Among the naga the women rule, and keep the old sorcery; the men are the larger and the more savage. Both are in Mathystra. Go back, $N, and this time go in. Six of their myrmidons and five of their sorceresses. Let them learn that this shore is watched.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Stormscale Myrmidons and 5 Stormscale Sorceresses in the Ruins of Mathystra, then return to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
texts.progress: Elune go with you. They do not fight singly if they can help it.
texts.completion:
It is done, and the Stormscale know that Auberdine will not look away.

I still cannot tell you why the sea gives up its dead on our sand. But I no longer think the sea is quiet. Something has stirred those who live in it, and Mathystra will not be the last ruin they come back for.

You have served the Temple well. Take this, with Elune's blessing.

idea: Chain 2 of 2: naga society (the women rule and keep the sorcery, Azshara revered as a goddess) and the Stormscale's hold on Mathystra. Uses enemies no quest used.
